title: Sunflower Girl Action Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a female character in a yellow sunflower-themed outfit against a solid green background. The character is shown standing with glowing hands, leaping with tail extended, stomping with an explosive ground effect, and crouching with smoke rising from her boots.
prompt: A four-panel sequence on a solid lime green background showing the same punk girl character with spiky black hair, sunflower goggles, and a yellow-black outfit with mechanical details and a long black tail. She wears heavy yellow boots. In the first panel she stands with glowing yellow energy around her hands and floating sunflower petals. Second panel she is mid-leap kicking forward with tail swinging. Third panel she stomps creating a bright yellow explosive burst at her feet. Final panel she crouches low with smoke rising from her boots and sunflowers on the ground. Comic book illustration style with bold black outlines.
